tools.name: captifi_get_account
tools.description: Confirm which CaptiFi account the API key belongs to: business name, plan and venue count. Good first call to test the connection. CaptiFi API: GET /me.

tools.name: captifi_list_venues
tools.description: List the venues on the account, alphabetically, with id, name, city, country and created_at. Use an id as venue_id in the guest and stats tools. CaptiFi API: GET /venues.

tools.name: captifi_list_guests
tools.description: List guests who arrived on the venue WiFi, newest first. Returns personal data (name, email, phone) and marketing_consent. Only arrivals appear, not contacts you imported yourself. Use from/to to limit the period. CaptiFi API: GET /guests.

tools.name: captifi_get_stats
tools.description: Get totals for a period: visits (every arrival), unique_guests (distinct people) and marketing_opt_ins. Defaults to the last 30 days across all venues. CaptiFi API: GET /stats.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: captifi_list_guests · Private data: captifi_get_account, captifi_list_guests · Public sink: captifi_list_guests.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: captifi_list_guests · Private data: captifi_get_account, captifi_list_guests · Public sink: captifi_list_guests

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
